summary.one_liner: Swetrix is an open-source, cookieless, GDPR-compliant web analytics platform that also includes error tracking, performance monitoring and session replays, available as a hosted cloud service or self-hosted Community Edition.
summary.what_it_does: Provides privacy-first website analytics without cookies or consent banners, covering top pages, geolocation with map view, devices, traffic sources and UTM campaigns in a real-time dashboard. Beyond pageviews it offers custom events and properties, sessions and user flows, funnels, real-user performance metrics (TTFB, DNS, TLS, render), and client-side error tracking. Session replays are available in both cloud and self-hosted editions, with the self-hosted version requiring S3-compatible storage. Sharing options include public or password-protected dashboards, team invites with roles, and CSV export plus a developer API. The README also describes cloud-only extras such as network intelligence (ISP, usage type), revenue analytics, alerts, feature flags and A/B experiments.
use_cases: replace Google Analytics with a privacy-friendly alternative
monitor website traffic without cookie banners
analyse conversion funnels and custom events
how_to_run: Self-host with Docker: deploy the API and UI with Docker (see the self-hosting guide)
Connect ClickHouse and Redis as required by the self-hosted setup
Configure a private S3-compatible bucket for session replay recordings
Alternatively, sign up for Swetrix Cloud (free trial, then paid plans)
notable: Combines web analytics with error tracking, performance monitoring and session replays in one product
Cookieless and GDPR-compliant design with no cross-device tracking
Open source under AGPLv3 with a self-hostable Community Edition
Includes a tracking script package and an npm client for the tracker
Hosted in the EU (Germany) on the cloud offering
caveats: Several features (network intelligence, revenue analytics, alerts, AI, session replay hosting, premium GeoIP) are cloud-only or need extra setup per the comparison table
Self-hosting requires managing servers, ClickHouse, Redis and S3-compatible storage yourself
Cloud offering is paid after a free trial (from $19/mo per the README); contributions are subject to a CLA
